organization_note: Amazon develops the Nova models, and Amazon Web Services, Inc., of Seattle, serves them through Amazon Bedrock; Kiro Enterprise plans are purchased and billed through AWS. The catalog names the developer Amazon and the Bedrock operator Amazon Web Services, so both names belong to this record. Its own science site states that Amazon scientists work "across the globe" and pins its research locations, and four of the pinned countries are not the United States: Brazil at Sao Paulo, the United Kingdom at London, Israel at Tel Aviv, and Spain at Madrid. The record keeps three, Brazil, the United Kingdom, and Israel, and the fourth, Spain, is left in this note rather than in a list a reader would take for complete.
